metadata.title: Admissions | Sanskriti Kindergarten Chennai
metadata.description: Apply for admissions at Sanskriti Kindergarten Chennai and learn about preschool, play school, kindergarten, and daycare enrollment.

hero.subtitle: Share your child's details and our admissions team will guide you through the right program, campus visit, and next steps.

image.alt: Children beginning their learning journey at Sanskriti Kindergarten

process.title: Admissions made calm, clear, and personal.
process.description: We keep the process parent-friendly: understand your child's age and routine, invite you for a conversation, then help you choose the right program.

steps.title: Share Details
steps.description: Tell us about your child, preferred program, and the best way to reach you.

steps.title: Plan a Visit
steps.description: Our team will help you schedule a campus visit or admissions call.

steps.title: Confirm Fit
steps.description: We guide you through age fit, routine, documents, and start date.

programs.title: Choose the path that suits your child.
programs.description: Sanskriti supports young children across preschool, play school, kindergarten, and daycare with a warm routine and steady teacher attention.

form.title: Tell us a little about your child.
form.description: Complete the form and our team will contact you to discuss availability, age fit, and the next visit slot.

closing.title: Prefer to speak before applying?
closing.description: Call us and we will walk you through program options, school timings, and admission availability.
